extendedData.value: Play epic multiplayer games in the world of Dungeons & Dragons. The Draconic Dissent Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur’s Gate Commander Deck includes 1 ready-to-play Blue-Red deck of 100 Magic cards (3 traditional foil, 97 nonfoil), a 2-card Collector Booster Sample Pack, 1 foil-etched Display Commander (a thick cardstock copy of the commander card with foil etched into the card’s border and art), 10 double-sided tokens, 1 deck box (can hold 100 sleeved cards), 1 life tracker, and 1 reference card. Introduces 10 MTG cards not found in the main CLB set.
